title: Mystic Tree of Realms
description: A massive, ancient tree with a glowing bulbous trunk and roots extending into a reflective pool stands centrally. Its branches bear colorful stained-glass leaves, while a luminous castle floats in the starry sky above, surrounded by auroras, waterfalls, birds, and ethereal figures.
prompt: A colossal fantasy tree with a large glowing bulbous trunk and intricate roots growing into a dark reflective pool of water. Its branches hold colorful stained-glass leaves resembling windows. Waterfalls flow from the sides, a bright castle floats in the starry night sky above the tree, surrounded by swirling aurora borealis, white birds, shooting stars, and glowing ethereal figures. Mystical, cosmic atmosphere with purple and teal tones.
